x: Two welcome re-appearances in action- Stan Davies and Ron Linstead, both recovered from illness that has kept them out of running for some time.
David Davies, a City of London Policeman and son of Stan Davies, took part in the recent Barking - Southend 34 miles walk. In only his second appearance he finished 25th of the 139 starters.
STAN DAVIES is now living at Haverhill (Suffolk) and is hoping to get in touch with WILL SPENCER who is also retired in that County. They used to enjoy Saturday runs with FRANK WEBB and Co.
Braggington did 14:38 to further increase our lead and then Len Adams returned 14:48 and when he handed over to Stan Davies the next team was not in sight.
A recent welcome visitor was Stan Davies, a good team man in his active days and a great club man. He is now settled in at his new home in Suffolk, near Haverhill.
Last October he cycled to Newmarket to see Stan Davies and sends regards to all and in particular Frank Webb, Norman Dewberry and Arthur Penstone,
Stan Davies (1914-2002) It is with much sadness that we have to announce the death of Stan Davies, who died on the 25th September 2002 from a heart attack, aged 88 years.
